S43.prompt: A tight close-up of the man from reference image 2, a real adult man with natural human proportions, normal-sized eyes and a lean face: the same face, short black curly hair, teal hoodie with white drawstrings and the straps of a tan canvas apron. Reference image 1 gives only the camera angle, the framing and the background; the cartoon figure in it becomes this real man, head and shoulders filling the frame. He stands on a city street corner at night and looks straight into the camera, lips parted mid-word as he raps, calm and knowing. Raindrops bead on his face and hair. Behind him, out of focus: a red brick wall and a rolled-down corrugated metal shutter on the left, a lit payphone and parked cars on the right, lit apartment windows above, wet asphalt reflecting the lights.
